flags: The cache provides no construction or designation-campaign history for the byway itself. The history paragraph follows the corridor’s navigation infrastructure; no road origin is invented.

Dropped the exact Pennsylvania-line and Waterville endpoints and the claim to follow the whole Ohio shoreline: the cache supports the 293-mile route and listed stops but does not establish those precise endpoints. The drive sequence follows the documented stop list east to west, reversing material’s general mile direction.

Ashtabula Harbor Light is retained with its exact title, coordinates and motifs, but kind is separate excursion because the cache says all access is by water. No tour or boat-service availability is promised.

Kelleys Island ferry and groove facts are supported but omitted for focus. ODOT attributes the grooves to glacier movement; Wikipedia discusses sediment-laden subglacial meltwater as their proposed mechanism. Avoid the current draft’s dragging analogy.

Marblehead’s continuous-operation superlative and Magee’s War of 1812 quotation are supported in Wikipedia but omitted in favor of specific historical changes. No unsupported present-day opening hours or tower access are asserted.
